review:
SixSixSix is a fiery slot where '6' symbols on reels 1, 3 and 5 trigger Wicked Wheels in their own positions. Blue wheels appear in the base game, with values including adding multipliers up to 100x, multiplying ones up to x10, a free spins trigger and an instant max win.

Red wheels appear in the bonuses with bigger values, up to 500x adding. Several wheels resolve from left to right, so the order of adding and multiplying results matters. The 16,666x maximum suits the theme, and there's an Epic version for players who want more.
